Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: This step is the first point where the team enters a loop by navigating to the wrong USPS calculator (Retail instead of International), which directly causes the subsequent data collection failure. The data_issue indicates that WebSurfer failed to retrieve valid USPS rate data because it used the domestic calculator, and this error was not immediately corrected, leading to an irreversible path where the correct rates could not be gathered.

The Subtask Name: Initial Planning and Team Assembly
Step Range: 0-1
The Oracle: Establishing the goal and assigning roles
Evidence: The human defines the task, and the Orchestrator creates an initial plan and assigns WebSurfer to look up FedEx rates.

The Subtask Name: FedEx Rate Lookup Attempt 1
Step Range: 2-3
The Oracle: Searching for FedEx rates via Bing
Evidence: WebSurfer searches Bing for FedEx rates and finds a link to the FedEx calculator.

The Subtask Name: FedEx Rate Lookup Attempt 2 (Navigation Failure)
Step Range: 4-5
The Oracle: Attempting to access the FedEx calculator but encountering a 404 error
Evidence: WebSurfer clicks the link, but the page shows "Page Not Found" and a location selection screen instead of the calculator.

The Subtask Name: DHL Rate Lookup Attempt
Step Range: 6-7
The Oracle: Attempting to look up DHL rates
Evidence: The Orchestrator instructs WebSurfer to look up DHL rates, but the conversation moves on without a successful result shown in the logs.

The Subtask Name: USPS Rate Lookup Attempt 1 (Search)
Step Range: 8-10
The Oracle: Searching for the USPS International Shipping Calculator
Evidence: The Assistant takes over, plans to look up USPS, and WebSurfer searches Bing for the USPS International Shipping Calculator.

The Subtask Name: USPS Rate Lookup Attempt 2 (Wrong Calculator)
Step Range: 11-12
The Oracle: Navigating to the USPS Retail Postage Price Calculator instead of the International one
Evidence: WebSurfer clicks a link that leads to the "Retail Postage Price Calculator," which is for domestic mail, not international.

The Subtask Name: USPS Rate Lookup Attempt 3 (Configuration)
Step Range: 13-15
The Oracle: Attempting to configure the USPS calculator for international mail
Evidence: WebSurfer clicks "International" in the dropdown, but the form still shows domestic fields (ZIP code to, etc.) and does not update to accept country selection.

The Subtask Name: USPS Rate Lookup Attempt 4 (Re-entry)
Step Range: 16-18
The Oracle: Re-attempting to input details into the USPS calculator
Evidence: The Orchestrator instructs WebSurfer to input ZIP code 06101 and select Colombia, but the interface remains stuck on the domestic form.

The Subtask Name: USPS Rate Lookup Attempt 5 (Stalled)
Step Range: 19-20
The Oracle: Repeatedly failing to select Colombia due to interface limitations
Evidence: WebSurfer clicks the destination country dropdown, but the list does not seem to include Colombia or the interaction fails to register.

The Subtask Name: Replanning and New Strategy
Step Range: 21-22
The Oracle: Recognizing the loop and creating a new plan to overcome challenges
Evidence: The Orchestrator detects a loop, identifies the root cause (navigation complexity), and creates a new plan to automate steps and verify inputs.

The Subtask Name: Final USPS Rate Lookup Attempt
Step Range: 23-24
The Oracle: Attempting to use the USPS calculator one last time with detailed instructions
Evidence: The Orchestrator gives detailed instructions to WebSurfer to fill in the form, but WebSurfer searches again, indicating the previous attempt failed or the tool reset.

The Subtask Name: System Failure and Termination
Step Range: 25-73
The Oracle: System errors and conversation termination
Evidence: WebSurfer encounters a "ResponsibleAIPolicyViolation" error from the model client, followed by connection errors and a crash of the scenario script, ending the conversation.
